arm_before.scope: Unit angular response per unit joint movement; zero discrepancy is correct.

arm_after.scope: Unit angular response per unit joint movement; zero discrepancy is correct.

observed_motion.scope: Observed displayed body only; joint angles and final actuator inputs, not inferred intentions.

finger_coordination.definition: All three flexion joints at least 90% of their positive bend limit simultaneously.
finger_coordination.scope: Displayed body only; recent states and saved command snapshots. Finger positions name distal body origins, not skin endpoints.

goal_progress_assessment.definition: Same captured state, model and goal: predicted sensory squared error of the selected command versus the starting controller proposal. Lower is closer. Positive reduction improves the prediction; zero no improvement; 100% would remove that error. This excludes the planner effort penalty and is not a physical comparison. Bodies in one planning event share a model; counts are not independent trials.
goal_progress_assessment.following_definition: Percentage of total requested angular distance removed during each executed 250ms command. 0% closes no gap, 100% arrives; negative moves away. The planner and exploration orders in these logs start from different moments; their difference is not causal.

rolling.scope: No learner or task reward is used. The auditor searches commands only to measure physical possibility; no found controller is installed or used as training.

fingers_before.scope: Fresh private body with production physical settings; four non-thumb fingers on each hand; forward-kinematic targets are auditor commands, not learned behavior. Direct torque uses each positive input limit and bypasses target interpretation and strength; endpoint trials use production smoothing and order duration.

trials.input_definition: Each tested flexion motor at its full positive input limit; learned strength bypassed.
